title: Boys playing marbles
content: Has anyone been in the mall, starting on the first floor (with someone you know), went up to the second floor (with the same person). Only to have to go to the bathroom, tell the person you’re with that you’ll be right back, go up to the 3rd floor, to see 2 young boys, no older than 6-8yrs old sitting on the floor playing marbles? The one sitting on the floor facing me has brown hair and brown eyes and just GLARES at me! I get to the bathroom passing them, (there’s more about insanely dirty bathrooms), but I’m just curious about if anyone has seen these boys playing marbles in their mall situations?? They’re the only things/beings I’m SUPER intimidated by and that are burned into my brain. No clue who they are, nor do I recognize them. Postscript: the elevators are strange too
